contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N VALEN-S P F AVG ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus of Valens, 364-378. Mint is Siscia, 367-375, Reece period 19. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N VALEN-S P F AVG. Reverse shows Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse fields and exergue read: R F/R-//.SIS. . Die axis is 7 o'clock, weight is 1.54g, diameter is 18.43mm. See…
